name: Sternal Fracture
definition: Fracture of the sternum after direct anterior chest trauma, often from motor-vehicle collisions or falls.

investigations.principle: CT or radiography identifies fracture; ECG/troponin evaluation is used when blunt cardiac injury is a concern.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, occult injury, postoperative or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Displaced unstable fractures or associated intrathoracic injuries require specialist care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Urah-bhagna phenotype may be documented only after cardiothoracic injury assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the sternum after direct anterior chest trauma, often from motor-vehicle collisions or falls.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, respiratory distress, progressive neurological deficit, open injury, severe deformity, infection or other listed red flags.
